item.title: Iranian parliament deputy speaker condemns US attack on wedding ceremony in Sirik
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Deputy Parliament Speaker Ali Nikzad has condemned a US attack on a wedding ceremony in Kuhestak, Sirik County, describing it as a continuation of the attacks on Minab and Lamerd on February 28, 2026, and saying Washington is seeking to disrupt everyday life in Iran.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86253281/Iranian-parliament-deputy-speaker-condemns-US-attack-on-wedding

Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Deputy Parliament Speaker Ali Nikzad has condemned a US attack on a wedding ceremony in Kuhestak, Sirik County, describing it as a continuation of the attacks on Minab and Lamerd on February 28, 2026, and saying Washington is seeking to disrupt everyday life in Iran.

item.title: IRGC destroys US surveillance balloon control system in Erbil
